blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns. In this lesson, "Forms and Papers", you learn the words that appear on Czarnikow's forms and reports.

Today you learn five useful words: paper, document, file, signature and copy. You also practise the plural: one paper, two papers; one document, two documents; one copy, two copies. The paper must be correct before we send the form.

Sophie explains the tax words slowly, in simple English. Go with calm — one step at a time. Taxes are just one more part of the company's routine, and they become easier with practice. You can do it!

items.q: What is the name of this lesson?
items.why: O texto diz: "In this lesson, 'Forms and Papers'".

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words: paper, document, file, signature and copy."

items.q: What is the plural of "copy"?
items.why: Palavras terminadas em consoante + y trocam o y por -ies: copy → copies.

items.q: The text suggests that taxes are…
options: a normal part of work that gets easier with practice
items.why: Inferência: "Taxes are just one more part of the company's routine… they become easier with practice."

items.q: Sophie would most likely AGREE that…
options: it is better to learn slowly, one step at a time
students should learn everything in one day
tax words are too hard for beginners
items.why: Inferência: "Sophie explains the tax words slowly… one step at a time."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie organizando a mesa antes da auditoria. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. My name is Sophie, and today is a busy day. The auditor comes this afternoon, so I need my desk ready.

Look at all these papers! I have many documents here. First, I put the tax forms in one file. The file is blue. Then I check the signatures. Every form needs a signature at the bottom.

I also make a copy of each document. One copy stays in the fiscal folder, and one copy goes to the accountant. We keep the copies for seven years.

This paper is not correct, so I put it here. I will fix it before lunch. One step at a time, and the desk is almost ready. I am calm, because I know my files well.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who comes this afternoon?
items.why: "The auditor comes this afternoon."

items.q: Where does Sophie put the tax forms?
items.why: "I put the tax forms in one file. The file is blue."

items.q: How long do they keep the copies?
items.why: "We keep the copies for seven years."

items.q: Why does Sophie put one paper on the side?
options: Because it is not correct and she will fix it
items.why: Inferência: "This paper is not correct, so I put it here. I will fix it before lunch."

items.q: How does Sophie feel about her work?
items.why: Inferência: "I am calm, because I know my files well" — ela está tranquila e organizada.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please sign this document and give it back to me." A document is…
items.why: Document = documento: um papel com informação importante.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The form is not valid without your ___ at the bottom."
items.why: Signature = assinatura: o que valida o formulário.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I keep one ___ for me and I send the other to the accountant."
items.why: Copy = cópia: você guarda uma e envia a outra.

items.q: "All the tax forms are in this file." A file is…
options: a folder that keeps papers together
items.why: File = arquivo/pasta: guarda os papéis juntos.

items.q: Choose the correct plural: "There are three ___ on the desk."
items.why: Plural simples: paper → papers, só com -s.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no dia a dia com formulários. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill out this form." To fill out means to…
options: write your information in the spaces
items.why: Fill out = preencher: escrever suas informações nos espaços.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "Please hand in the document before Friday." To hand in means to…
options: give it to the right person
items.why: Hand in = entregar o documento à pessoa certa.

items.q: "I will print out a copy for the auditor." To print out means to…
options: make a paper copy from the computer
items.why: Print out = imprimir: fazer uma cópia em papel a partir do computador.

items.q: "Can you check over these papers before we send them?" To check over means to…
options: look at them carefully for mistakes
items.why: Check over = revisar, olhar com atenção para achar erros.
